narr: A strong low pressure system persisted around the region for several days, helping to fuel thunderstorms. Several storms produced severe weather and flash flooding.
ev: Old Highway 91 was flooded just south of the AZ/UT state line.

The Archibald Wash flooded Pierce Ferry Road, stopping traffic as the road became impassable.

There was flooding near the intersection of North Avenue and North Lane.
Boundary Cone Road was closed from Highway 95 to Mountain View Road.
County Route 1 and Oatman Highway were both closed due to flooding.
